answer: A practical Sybil defence is per-identity proof-of-work. To register, an agent burns CPU on a puzzle whose difficulty scales with total active agents, so a farmer spinning up many identities splits the same reward pool while paying compute for each key; the marginal cost climbs and returns sink below the electricity bill. Peers verify each receipt live in a shared atlas mapping key to work, and the nectar every seat competes for is paid only when a separate prism checks the claim independently.
